**Latest Fervo Energy News (as of 2026-10-09)**

**1. First Power achieved at Cape Station — commercial operation declared ahead of schedule**
Fervo Energy (Nasdaq: FRVO) reached First Power at Cape Station on Sept. 24, 2026, putting the first operating megawatts from its flagship Utah development onto the grid. The first GeoBlock (~33 MW) is part of a project with approximately 900 MW of fully contracted offtake and a multi-gigawatt design (4+ GW planned). Phase I is ~100 MW across three ~33-MW GeoBlocks, with GeoBlocks 2 and 3 expected to reach initial power in early 2027; Phase II adds ~400 MW via eight 50-MW GeoBlocks in 2028.
Sources: [Fervo Hits First Power as Cape Station Geothermal Build Scales (Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/energy/articles/fervo-hits-first-power-cape-120500060.html); [Fervo Energy declares commercial operation at Cape Station ahead of schedule](https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-declares-commercial-operation-at-cape-station-ahead-of-schedule-leading-the-race-for-next-generation-geothermal-energy/); [World's first enhanced geothermal power plant completed in just 23 months (TechCrunch)](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/worlds-first-enhanced-geothermal-power-plant-completed-in-just-23-months/?utm_source=tldrnewsletter)

**2. Two U.S. Department of Energy awards (~$20M total) for Idaho and Nevada EGS**
Announced September 22, 2026: one grant for drilling/completing EGS wells in Elmore County, Idaho (with national labs, plus high-temperature geophone tech testing), and one for a targeted appraisal campaign at a high-priority EGS prospect in Humboldt County, Nevada. Fervo's EGS commercial pilot, Project Red, has generated 3 MW of gross power to the Nevada grid since 2023.
Source: [Fervo Energy Secures Two U.S. Department of Energy Awards (Fervo Energy)](https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-secures-two-u-s-department-of-energy-awards-to-develop-next-generation-geothermal-in-idaho-and-nevada/); also noted on [LinkedIn (Fervo Energy)](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/fervo-energy_fervo-energy-has-been-awarded-two-grants-activity-7508260021005312000-cftB)

**3. Q2 2026 results (reported August 12, 2026)**
Fervo raised its long-term development target to 1.1 GW by 2030 (a 100-MW increase), advanced Cape Station Phase I toward commercial operation (mechanical completion on GeoBlocks 1 and 2), and set a new company drilling record with Sawtooth 7 — reaching nearly 19,500 feet measured depth in a 460°F resource. Financially, the quarter showed a net loss of ~$55.9M, operating loss of $28.7M, capex of $226.5M, minimal revenue ($110,000), $2.1B in cash, total debt of $228.4M, and a $7.2B revenue backlog backed by 658 MW under binding PPAs. Management guided 2027 revenue of $60–80M and H2 2026 capex of $850–900M. The stock fell 4.14% to $23.17 after the presentation.
Sources: [Fervo Energy Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results](https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-reports-second-quarter-2026-results/); [Fervo Q2 2026 slides: drilling gains offset $55.9M loss (Investing.com)](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/fervo-q2-2026-slides-drilling-gains-offset-559m-loss-93CH-4855607); [Fervo Energy Q2 2026 results, cash and build-out | 10-Q (StockTitan)](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FRVO/10-q-fervo-energy-co-quarterly-earnings-report-af859383d30c.html)

**4. Google 3 GW framework agreement and PPA backlog**
Fervo signed a Geothermal Framework Agreement with Google to support development of up to 3 GW of geothermal capacity through 2033, alongside a disclosed $7.2B contracted PPA backlog and fully subscribed 400 MW Cape Station offtake with buyers including Southern California Edison and Shell Energy.
Sources: [Fervo Energy Reports First Quarter 2026 Results](https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-reports-first-quarter-2026-results/); [Fervo Energy Geothermal 2026, 400 MW Cape Station PPA (ENKI)](https://enkiai.com/geothermal/fervo-energy-data-center-ppa/)

**5. Financing and IPO backdrop**
Fervo closed a $421M oversubscribed non-recourse project financing for Cape Station Phase I (March 19, 2026), with Coordinating Lead Arrangers including Barclays, BBVA, HSBC, MUFG, RBC, and Société Générale. Its Q1 2026 report (June 22, 2026) confirmed the Nasdaq IPO on May 14, 2026 at $27.00/share (80.5M Class A shares, ~$2.2B gross proceeds). Related commentary notes a ~$1.2B expected near-term CapEx tied largely to Cape Station and a "hottest well in its history" discovery ~10 miles northeast of Cape Station.
